# maro env create

Create an OpenShift configmap or secret.

## Usage

```bash
maro env create
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Alias | Type | Description |
| -------- | ----- | ---- | ----------- |
| None     | None  | None | None        |

## Notes

- Requires `paths.namespaces` to be set in your configuration.
- Lets you select whether to create a configmap or a secret.
